items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Georgie told this character, he said 'Listen here, fellow, anytime I come in this place, and somebody's a personal friend of mine, don't you ever try to insult them... Said don't you ever do that to my friends.'

ctx.x: They would come up to Harlem and hang out all the joints, to steal, see what the cats was putting out. They could play what was on paper, but you couldn't tell them go on out there and play me some choruses. We had a bass player Bass Edwards, he used to record with us a lot. Played one of them big Sousaphones, this cat played with Charlie Johnson

band at Small's Paradise. Charlie Johnson had a good band. (Stafford) Georgie, his drummer, Jabo, and all them sharks in there. This this big. And he had a light in the bell. He'd take the tray and fan Bass Edwards, he took a waiter's tray, like the trumpet player play and play you ten choruses like on the trumpet and he always had cigar, never take it out of his mouth.
